beats.say: If someone steals your phone, can they use your number in another phone?
Your phone number receives your sign-in codes, so it is worth protecting on its own.
Most phones let you add a SIM PIN, asked for every time the phone restarts.
Ask your mobile provider for the starting PIN first, because wrong tries can lock the card.
Then change it to a code only you know and keep it somewhere safe.
Look for SIM lock in your settings today, and send this to someone who travels a lot.
